source.title: Insect Identification in the Wild: The AMI Dataset

creators.name: Anctil, Alexandre
creators.affiliation: Centre de données sur le patrimoine naturel du Québec

rights.basis: The Zenodo DATASET record itself declares MIT; selected assets are original AMI-Traps camera-trap photographs explicitly described by the in-archive readme. This does not rely only on an unrelated software repository license.
rights.reuse_condition: Retain the copyright and permission notice with redistributed copies; attribute the dataset and distinguish any later crops or overlays.
rights.scope: Only the three selected AMI-Traps originals and their dataset annotations. No blanket relicense claim for AMI-GBIF third-party photographs or AMI Companion test images.
rights.recommended_credit: Jain et al. (2024), Insect Identification in the Wild: The AMI Dataset, v2, doi:10.5281/zenodo.12554005. Copyright (c) 2024 RolnickLab. MIT license.

download.method: HTTP Range to official archive; ZIP64 central directory plus selected members only
download.reason_full_hash_not_checked: The 16 GB archive was not downloaded; each selected member passed its published ZIP central-directory CRC32 and uncompressed-size checks.

sequence.visual_observation: Similar textured white background and lighting across the three photos; this is not a substitute for a deployment ID.
sequence.safe_use: Same-night nearby-time image comparison. Do not state these are every successive exposure, verified individual tracks, or exact UKCEH manual demonstration frames.
sequence.scientific_identity_claim: No individual moth identity is inferred across the three photos.

frames.timezone_note: Original raw tag retained; do not infer an exact recording location or independently validated timezone.

viewing_notes: All three full images were visually inspected; each includes multiple visible moths and non-moth insects.
First image has a clearly visible patterned moth below and right of center; author annotation Hydriomena furcata.
Third image has a large blurred shape near the lower-left corner; the dataset labels it Unidentifiable. Do not present it as a confident moth identification.
Species, genus, family and order annotations coexist. Keep the authors annotation rank; do not promote coarse labels to species.

preferred_first_frame_roi.note: Author dataset annotation, not a fresh AI prediction; preserve original image and use a reversible display crop.
